name: Xiantao Municipal Big Data Center Machine Room Project
developer: Xiantao Municipal Big Data Center
notes: Listed in Xiantao 14th Five-Year new-infrastructure plan as the city big-data-center machine-room project (power, cooling, fire protection, security, cabling, cloud platform) proposed at public security bureau buildings 8-9. Small civic facility; no MW disclosed. Verified per CN methodology filing/plan channel.

name: Xiantao New-Generation Government Cloud / City Operations Center Machine Room
developer: Xiantao municipal government
notes: Hubei Daily (May 2026) reports operational city-operations-center room running dozens of domestic-CPU servers, 80+ government systems and about 2 billion data records. Small civic cloud facility rather than hyperscale IDC; web search for Xiantao commercial IDC projects returned no large facilities.

name: Dawu Artificial Intelligence Computing Center
developer: Unspecified investor with Dawu County support
notes: Hubei Science and Technology Department: project landed in Dawu County Economic Experimental Development Zone; planned investment CNY260m, phase-one CNY100m, 200 data cabinets, up to 3,000 servers, 8,000T storage, T3 standard, plus 10MW rooftop PV and 10MW/20MWh storage.

name: Xiaogan Yunqi Computing Power Project
developer: Xiaogan Yunqi Data Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Filed 2025-10-22 in Xiaogan High-Tech Development Zone; total investment about CNY300m, 500 sqm, 128 NVIDIA H200 servers, construction Dec 2025-Mar 2026, planned to serve Ningbo Unicom.

name: Yangtze 3D Scientific Computing Center / Xiaogan Computing Power Industrial Park
developer: Xiaogan Gaocuang Investment Co., Ltd. / Lianguang Yuanhe (Xiaogan) Optical Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Xinhua Hubei: first CNY300m phase completed May 2023 as part of the CNY11.2bn Xiaogan computing industrial park; C114 describes MaPU-based 3D scientific-computing cluster with about 110P compute.

name: Three Gorges Dongyuemiao Data Center
developer: China Three Gorges Corp / Three Gorges Hi-Tech
notes: Green hydro-powered DC on right bank of Three Gorges Dam. Phase one commissioned with about 4,400 cabinets; full plan 5 DC buildings and 26,400 cabinets. Three Gorges Hi-Tech page advertises hosting plus GPU compute services.

name: Dianjun District Artificial Intelligence Computing Center
developer: Yichang Dianjun District / Enflame Technology ecosystem
notes: Hubei Data Bureau describes Yichang large-scale compute cluster; Dianjun AI computing project total investment about CNY300m using domestic AI compute. Yeez case page: heterogeneous intelligent computing center for smart-city, culture/tourism, finance, education.

name: National Advanced Computing Industry Innovation Center (Yichang)
developer: Sugon / Yichang Dianjun District partners
notes: CNR: three Dianjun compute centers lit up; this project is CNY3.02bn, EPC+O delivery, planned completion 2025, 500P mixed compute at full buildout.

name: Yichang Ultra-Large-Scale Artificial Intelligence Computing Power Center
developer: Yichang municipal data authorities / Dianjun Electronic Information Industrial Park
notes: Yichang Data Bureau official article (2025-01-17): city built intelligent-computing scale exceeding 2000P and planned/under-construction scale above 10000P; National Advanced Computing Industry Innovation Center (Yichang), Information High-speed Railway Central China Hub station and Dianjun AI computing center lit up together in Dianjun Electronic Information Industrial Park; article features render image of new ultra-large AI computing power center.

name: City Cloud Changde Data Center
developer: Hunan City Cloud Big Data Industry Development Co., Ltd.
notes: Opened in Changde Economic Development Zone 2024-09-22. Government source: national A-grade data center, 10,000 sqm, 1,000 server cabinets, planned 2,000P delivery, phase-one investment CNY350m and 500P delivered.

name: Changde Langhe Big Data Center
developer: Langhe / Changde High-Tech Zone project company
notes: Groundbreaking 2023-10-30 in Changde High-Tech Zone; expected total investment CNY1.88bn, three phases, about 10,000 8kW cabinets, expected annual output CNY1.2bn after full completion.

name: China Telecom Tianyi Cloud Central-South Digital Industrial Park
developer: China Telecom / Tianyi Cloud
notes: Major Changsha Tianxin project; Hunan MIIT reported groundbreaking with Tianyi Cloud investment of CNY12bn. Hunan action plan: about 300 mu, 280,000 sqm, 22 buildings, planned 21,128 standard racks, 692.32 PFLOPS, 2,641PB storage.

name: China Unicom Changsha Cloud Data Center
developer: China Unicom Hunan
notes: Hunan compute-capability action plan identifies this as Unicom's largest Central-South cloud data center and five-star facility; 3,200 standard racks planned, 1,633.6 built at the time, 104.86 PFLOPS design compute, 400PB design storage.

name: National Supercomputing Center in Changsha
developer: Hunan Province / Hunan University / National University of Defense Technology
notes: National supercomputing facility; MOST described 2014 startup; Hunan government reported 2025 that Tianhe next-generation host reaches 200P Flops peak and 1000P Flops AI compute.

name: Changsha 5A Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Changsha AI computing-center operators / local digital economy partners
notes: Hunan's first 5A intelligent computing center unveiled online in Changsha using 1+N platform model.

name: China Unicom Hengyang Big Data Center
developer: China Unicom Hengyang Branch
notes: Hengyang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau issued completion acceptance notice 2024. Project in Hengyang High-Tech Zone, started June 2021, about CNY300m current-phase investment, about 26 mu planned land.

name: Hengyang County Big Data Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Hengyang County Data Bureau
notes: FSR approval by Hengyang County DRC 2025-01-26. Project code 2411-430421-04-01-420396, investment CNY189m, Xidu Town Yingnan New District; IDC rooms, digital rooms, compute resource pool, 20 CPU servers, 180T high-speed storage.

name: Huaihua Cloud Computing Center
developer: Huaihua municipal government / city cloud operators
notes: Huaihua implementation opinion: all government compute infrastructure coordinated around Huaihua Cloud Computing Center; consolidation target by end-2025; 2025 target 1,000 standard racks, 30 PFLOPS compute, 20PB storage.

name: Hunan Mobile Loudi 5G Cloud Data Center
developer: China Mobile Hunan / Loudi Mobile
notes: Groundbreaking of CNY350m project on 16,700 sqm; phase one production dispatch building with 5G core room and big-data room; Loudi's largest 5G cloud data operations center.

name: Loudi Municipal Data Center / Government Cloud System
developer: Loudi Data Bureau and local government-cloud providers
notes: Loudi MIIT: five data centers totaling 179 standard racks and 10 PLOPS compute; Hunan MIIT later describes government cloud plus police cloud, carrier public cloud and Xianggu big-data-center computing-infrastructure system.

name: Dongjiang Lake Big Data Industrial Park / Green Data Valley
developer: Zixing/Chenzhou governments with Hunan Telecom, Hunan Yunchao Technology and park operators
notes: Large Chenzhou/Zixing cluster using Dongjiang Lake cold-water resources. 3.3 sq km-plus / 5,000 mu park, planned CNY50bn investment, up to 200,000 racks and 5 million servers. By 2026 five data-center projects landed, serving 74 enterprises with about 700 PFLOPS aggregate compute.

name: Yunchao Dongjiang Lake Big Data Center
developer: Hunan Telecom / Hunan Yunchao Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Flagship operational DC in Dongjiang Lake park; Hunan government describes it as built/operated by Hunan Telecom and Hunan Yunchao; county coverage says Yunchao center had about 3,600 operating racks at 80% utilization.

name: Yixin Technology (Yeqi) No.2 Data Center
developer: Yixin Technology / Yeqi
notes: County-government article on Dongjiang Lake Green Data Valley: Yixin Technology (Yeqi) No.2 building data center completed as one of the park's landed projects.

name: Chenzhou City Investment Dongjiang Lake No.2 and No.3 Data Centers
developer: Chenzhou City Investment / local state-owned platform
notes: County-government article reports City Investment No.2 and No.3 building data centers completed in Dongjiang Lake Big Data Industrial Park.

name: Xinchi Computing Power Center
developer: Xinchi / Dongjiang Lake park partners
notes: County-government article: Xinchi Computing Power Center among Dongjiang Lake park data-center projects about to start construction.

name: China Unicom Dongjiang Lake Big Data Center
developer: China Unicom
notes: County-government article: China Unicom Dongjiang Lake Big Data Center among park projects about to start construction.

name: Xiangtan Xinchuang Government Cloud Platform / Cloud on Xiangtan
developer: Xiangtan Municipal Big Data and Industrial Innovation Development Center
notes: Municipal cloud infrastructure supporting 125 government systems; article also identifies Hunan Big Data Industrial Park and digital industry chain in Xiangtan. Physical datacenter capacity not disclosed.

name: Alibaba Cloud Innovation Center (Xiangtan) Big Data Industrial Base
developer: Xiangtan High-tech Zone; Alibaba Cloud; Hunan Bayun Technology
notes: Alibaba Cloud page: Xiangtan High-tech Zone, Alibaba Cloud and Hunan Bayun jointly built big-data industrial base, launched July 2020; appears to be industrial/cloud enablement base rather than large colocation datacenter.

name: Xiangxi Prefecture Big Data Center / Government Cloud Platform
developer: Xiangxi Prefecture Smart City Office / Xiangxi Prefecture Government
notes: About RMB400m invested; prefecture big-data-center computer room completed, phase-one cloud platform in use; later provincial statistics article confirms integration with government cloud and data-sharing platforms.

name: Furong Cloud Big Data Center
developer: Furong Cloud / China Capital Investment Management and partners
notes: Yiyang High-tech Zone facility launched 2018. Planned 20,000 high-density racks, phase one 6,000 racks, T4 standard, about 450 mu total land. Yiyang 2023-2025 plan names Furong Cloud as core of city compute support system.

name: Yiyang High-tech Zone AI Supercomputing Center Project
developer: Yiyang High-tech Zone
notes: Official investment-promotion notice describes planned AI computing center with total capacity of 20,000 high-density cabinets; exact MW not disclosed.

name: Huawei (Yongzhou) Cloud Computing Data Center
developer: Huawei Cloud; Yongzhou Economic and Technological Development Zone
notes: Introduced April 2016, officially online later; phase one 13,924.92 sqm GFA, 1,000 standard server cabinets, 480,000-core cloud computing, 45P cloud storage; one of Huawei's 22 core nodes and Huawei's only node in Hunan.

name: Yueyang Cloud Data Center / China Telecom Yueyang Cloud Computing Center
developer: China Telecom Yueyang Branch
notes: Rednet: Yueyang big data cloud center room completed at China Telecom Yueyang branch, marking cloud computing center project landing in Yueyang. Capacity not disclosed.

name: China Unicom Hunan Central-South Research Institute Yueyang Cloud Data Center (Core Office Building)
developer: China Unicom Hunan / China United Network Communications
notes: Yueyang planning bureau published detailed-plan adjustment pre-approval for 2024 cloud data center/core office building project. Yueyang 2025 reply: city had 7 compute centers, 5 built, 2 under construction, over 3,200 designed racks and 9P general compute.

name: Zhangjiajie Smart City Cloud Computing Big Data Center
developer: Zhangjiajie municipal e-government / Inspur
notes: Zhangjiajie e-government rules require qualifying government hardware centrally hosted in municipal smart-city cloud-computing big-data-center room; Inspur case material describes unified cloud resource pool for city agencies.

name: Zhangjiajie Metaverse Pilot Base Data Center / Server Room
developer: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park related project sponsors
notes: Project launched with planned investment over RMB50m; online component includes cultural-tourism big data center, offline includes server integration and constant-temperature computer room. Small specialized facility; MW not disclosed.

name: China Mobile (Hunan Zhuzhou) Data Center / Big Data Center
developer: China Mobile Hunan
notes: Among South China's largest: about 300 mu site, 8 DC rooms plus support buildings, 160,000 sqm machine-room area, planned about 30,000 racks, infrastructure investment near RMB4bn, supports at least 280,000 servers; phase one operational, phase two planned completion June 2024.

name: China Mobile (Hunan Zhuzhou) Data Center Phase II
developer: China Mobile Hunan; Hunan No.3 Engineering Co.
notes: Phase II started Oct 2022, investment over RMB1bn, two data-center buildings and support works, expected 13,000-rack capability when built.

name: Inner Mongolia Tengger Haitao Cloud Green Smart Computing Center
developer: Inner Mongolia Haitao Cloud Data Technology Co. / local Alxa partners
notes: Signed in Alxa League Luanjingtan Ecological Migration Demonstration Zone 2025-03-05, RMB4.5bn investment, green intelligent-computing plus renewable-energy model, planned 10,000P high-performance compute cluster. MW not disclosed.

name: Baotou Cloud Computing Center
developer: Sugon / Baotou municipal and district governments
notes: Signed 2011-2012 with Sugon; phase one opened within half a year as Inner Mongolia's first operating cloud-computing center; later described as commercial cloud computing center and enterprise R&D platform.

name: Baotou Rare Earth High-tech Zone Cloud Computing Big Data Center
developer: Baotou Rare Earth High-tech Zone
notes: Construction began July 2016, total investment RMB18.995m, phase-one acceptance covered equipment delivery, installation, debugging and infrastructure cloud deployment.

name: Baogang Industrial Internet Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Baogang / Baotou industrial internet project sponsors
notes: Baotou's first East-Data-West-Computing compute project; first batch operating stably by Oct 2024; data center building plus operations building, 10 machine-room zones, 1,358 high-density compute racks, eventual 20,000P compute scale (total investment about CNY3.84bn per Sohu roundup).

name: Baotou Maifushi AI Digital Zero-Carbon Park Demonstration Base
developer: Baotou Maifushi Technology Co.
notes: RMB3bn project filed by Baotou Rare Earth High-tech Zone Economic Development Bureau 2026-03-04; planned Mar 2026-Mar 2029; AI hardware, zero-carbon management, industrial collaboration, government intelligence.

name: JD Bayannur Cloud Computing Data Center
developer: JD.com
notes: 2012 framework: RMB2bn Bayannur cloud-computing data center, phase one planned 4 cloud-computing data centers, 150,000-200,000 servers, 800PB storage, 1,920THz compute. Later completion/operation not confirmed in this pass; status unknown.

name: Inner Mongolia Tianji Wulate Zhongqi Intelligent Computing Data Center
developer: Inner Mongolia Tianji Intelligent Computing Technology Co.
notes: Bayannur's first intelligent-computing center project started in Wulate Zhongqi 2026-04-11; planned investment RMB16bn, 200 mu, total compute 50,000P; phase one RMB430m for 3,000P green intelligent-computing center. Sina Finance (2026-03) separately lists a Bayannur Wulate Zhongqi compute project among 6 Inner Mongolia filing approvals.

name: Wulate Zhongqi Zero-Carbon Port Logistics Hub 'Honggang Shujian' Intelligent Computing Project
developer: Wulate Zhongqi / project company not confirmed
notes: RMB89.9673m intelligent-computing zero-carbon port logistics hub project in Ganqimaodu, Wulate Zhongqi. Small edge/industry compute activity.
